title: A resolution supporting the mission and goals of National Fentanyl Awareness Day in 2025, including increasing individual and public awareness of the impact of fake or counterfeit fentanyl pills on families and young people.
latestAction: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S2643; text: CR S2669)
summary: This resolution designates April 29, 2025, as National Fentanyl Awareness Day to bring attention to the impact of fake or counterfeit fentanyl pills.
